p: asked not for me: Meaning, the Gentiles who know not God, would seek him, when he had moved their heart with his Holy Spirit, Ro 10:20.

spread out my hands all the: He shows the reason for the rejection of the Jews, because they would not obey him or any admonition of his prophets, by whom he called them continually and stretch out his hand to draw them.
thoughts: He shows that to delight in our own fantasies is the declining from God and the beginning of all superstitions and idolatry.
gardens: Which were dedicated to idols.
brick: Meaning their altars, which he thus named by contempt.
graves: To consult with spirits, and to conjure devils, which was forbidden.
swine's flesh: Which was contrary to God's commandment, Le 11:7, De 14:8.
Stand by thyself: He shows that hypocrisy is always joined with pride and contempt of others.
burneth all the day: Their punishment will never have an end.
written before me: So that the remembrance of it cannot be forgotten.
together: Will be both punished together: and this declares how the children are punished for their fathers faults, that is, when the same faults or like are found in them.
blessing is in it: That is, it is profitable: meaning that God will not destroy the faithful branches of his vineyard, when he destroys the rotten stocks, that is, the hypocrites.
Sharon shall be a fold of: Which was a plentiful place in Judea to feed sheep, as Achor was for cattle.
troop: By the multitude and number he means their innumerable idols of whom they thought they could never have enough.
number you to the sword: Seeing you cannot number your gods, I will number you with the sword.
spoke: By my prophets, whom you would not obey.

eat: By these words, eat and drink, he means the blessed life of the faithful, who have always had consolation and full contentment of all things in their God, though sometimes they lack these corporal things.
chosen: Meaning, that he would call the Gentiles, who would abhor even the very name of the Jews for their infidelities sake.
another name: Than by the name of the Jews.

earth shall bless himself in the: By blessing, and by swearing is meant the praising of God for his benefits, and the true worshipping of him, who will not be only in Judea, but through all the world.
troubles are forgotten: I will no longer permit my Church to be desolate as in times past.
new heavens and a new earth: I will so altar and change the state of my church, that it will seem to dwell in a new world.

not filled his days: Meaning, in this wonderful restoration of the Church there would be no weakness of youth, nor infirmities of age, but all would be fresh and flourishing: and this is accomplished in the heavenly Jerusalem, when all sins will cease, and the tears will be wiped away.
an hundred years old shall be: By which he shows that the infidels and unrepentant sinners have no part of this benediction.
build houses: He proposes to the faithful the blessings which are contained in the law, and so under temporal things comprehends the spiritual promises.
wolf and the lamb shall feed: Read Isa 11:6.
